title: Derived functors inherit an adjunction
statement: Given an adjunction $G\dashv F$ between categories, localizations $L_1,L_2$ of the source and target, and absolute left and right derived functors $G'$ and $F'$ with the required derived comparison morphisms $\alpha$, $\beta$ [def-pc-derived-category], the derived functors form an adjunction $G'\dashv F'$. Its counit $\varepsilon'$ is induced by the underived counit $\varepsilon$: for every object $X$, $G'(\beta_X)\circ\varepsilon'_{L X}=\alpha_{F X}\circ L(\varepsilon_X)$.

mathlib_searches.query: derived extension of an adjoint pair gives an adjunction on derived categories

mathlib_searches.results: line 125: G'.map (β.app X₂) ≫ (adj.derivedε W₂ α β).app (L₂.obj X₂) = α.app (F.obj X₂) ≫ L₂.map (adj.counit.app X₂)

mathlib_match.how: generalization: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derived (line 144) constructs the derived adjunction under the stated absolute-derived-functor hypotheses; its counit is Adjunction.derivedε, whose compatibility with the underived counit is CategoryTheory.Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app (same file, line 125)
